와규스테이크는 부드럽고 풍미가 가득했으며 문어요리도 쫄깃하고 부드러우며 맛있었어요. 전체적으로 요리에 굉장히 공들였다는 느낌이 들었습니다. 한국에 있었어도 굉장히 호평받을만한 팬시한 레스토랑이에요! 

여기서 저녁식사하고 마카티에 위치한 루프탑바가서 칵테일까지 마셔주면 근사한 코스 완성입니다. 골목 곳곳에 숨어있는 예쁜 바들도 참 많아요. 젊은 사람들 데이트 혹은 칠링하러 삼삼오오 인산인해인 곳입니다. 우리나라 이태원 느낌도 나요! 다만 아주 늦은 밤에 여자 혼자 다니는것은 비추! 아무래도 이곳은 필리핀이니까 혼자 오신 여행객은 항상 조심해서 나쁠 것 없습니다

If you want to have a special dinner in Manila, I highly recommend BlackBird located in Makati. I went to BlackBird in Makati based on a friend’s recommendation, and it had a great atmosphere and delicious food. However, the prices are a bit steep; it felt like I was in Apgujeong. 

The wagyu steak was tender and full of flavor, and the octopus dish was chewy, tender, and delicious. Overall, you can tell they put a lot of effort into their dishes. Even if it were in Korea, it would receive rave reviews as a fancy restaurant!

After having dinner here, head to a rooftop bar in Makati for cocktails to complete a wonderful evening. There are many beautiful bars hidden in the alleys. It’s a place bustling with young people on dates or just chilling out. It has a vibe similar to Itaewon in Korea! However, I don‘t recommend women walking alone very late at night, solo travelers should always be cautious😈✨🍷
